name: Galápagos Conservancy Conservation Action Grants
summary: Annual competitive grants (Small Grants for conservation actions and WISE for women in sustainable enterprises) for conservation and sustainability work in the Galápagos province, open to permanent residents.

amount.note: Average US$5,000, up to US$10,000 in exceptional cases
